object.description: Steps: Run SplitAccumulatorTest. Expected: A split completes exactly at the 1000 m boundary; 1200 m then 900 m complete two splits and leave 100 m (200 m excess carried); a 1609.344 m boundary completes a split at 1610 m. Passing proves the split rule for both distance units in isolation, not the recording-state gating (see PACE-STS-44).
